title: Gchair
award: Honorable Mention, 2007 National Creative Furniture Design Competition
summary: Inspired by the treble clef, this design translates musical rhythm into form, making furniture a melody within a space.

title: Water’s Echo in Wood
award: Selected, 2008 Taiwan International Wood Sculpture Competition
summary: A sound of water, ripples unfolding — seeking a fleeting stir within, holding, for a moment, its resonance.

title: Seen Through
title_zh: 透明公廁的環境知覺調查
summary: A phone-based study of Shigeru Ban's transparent public toilet in Haru-no-Ogawa Community Park, Tokyo. Participants pick a booth and live through four visual boundaries in it: always opaque, always frosted, frosted on locking (the real design) and always clear. They rate privacy and safety before entering and after locking, and answers go straight to Google Sheets. The project page explains the method and lists its references.

title: Architecture App
title_zh: 與 AI 協作的網站與專題導覽
summary: How this website and the Seen Through final project were made with AI: full scripts in Chinese and English, before-and-after comparisons, diagrams and a one-page A4 handout.
